mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing fluphenazine plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including extrapyramidal symptoms and QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for signs of fluphenazine toxicity (tremor, rigidity, akathisia); consider dose reduction of fluphenazine if adverse effects emerge or baseline ECG monitoring for QT interval.
